overview: Mid-market CX platform selling agent UI + routing. Want streaming agent suggestions overlay, automatic ticket summarization, and tool-calls into their ticketing/CRM. High concurrency during Black Friday-style events; primary constraint is predictable latency and strict residency for EU customers.
sales_notes: Buying sponsor: VP Product (Morgan Lee) - cares about agent throughput and reduction in AHT
Procurement timeline: vendor review in April; legal/infosec reviews take 6-8 weeks
Price sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity for predictable cost during spikes

technical_requirements: Workload: streaming token-by-token suggestions in agent UI, plus end-of-call ticket summary generation
Latency SLO: 95th pct token latency <= 200ms for 512-token context; cold-start fallback <= 400ms
Throughput: avg 120 concurrent agents on weekdays, spike to 1,200 concurrent during promos
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family or Llama-derivatives with quantization profiles; allow Redwood-verified variants
Routing/fallback: primary Dedicated pool in us-west, fallback to hosted EU/NA regions; automatic downgrade to cheaper model under overload
Guardrails: hallucination checks, tool-call safety policies (deny write actions without agent confirmation), pii redaction pre-output
Caching: prefix/KV caching required for scripted prompts and customer context to reduce cost
Telemetry: token-level traces, per-suggestion timing, and sampling of full responses for QA
poc_plan: Phase 0 (2 wks): integrate SDK, spike test harness; validate streaming websocket for suggestions
Phase 1 (4 wks): run staged load tests to 1k concurrent; measure 95p latency and cost per suggestion
Phase 2 (2 wks): security review + SAML SSO test in VPC deployment; encryption key exchange via KMS
Acceptance criteria: 95p latency <= 200ms at 120 concurrent; graceful degradation path documented for 1,200 concurrent spikes
integration_notes: Plan to call Redwood APIs from agent UI via company backend to avoid exposing keys; backend will orchestrate model routing
Tool-calls: need a pre-flight validation step so model suggestions can propose ticket updates but require agent click to apply
Data residency: EU tenant data must remain in eu-central region; need Private control plane or dedicated regional pool
Monitoring hooks: will use Redwood Console traces and push custom logs to Splunk
risks_and_blockers: Infosec requires annual penetration test for any vendor with access to customer PII
